αἰδοίη: αἰδοῖος — held in respect, revered; fem. nom. sg.
αἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. (αἵ μοι ἕποντο ’which followed me’) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό: fem. nom. pl. demonstrative ’they’ (ἔνθ’ αἵ γ’ ’there they’)
αἶψ: αἶψα — quickly, swiftly; adv., elided (αἶψ’ = αἶψα)
αὐδῆς: αὐδή — voice, speech, utterance; fem. gen. sg., governed by ἔκλυες ’you heard’
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately, forthwith; adv.
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο)
αὐτόν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’himself’, or reinforcing a pronoun of any person (με … καὶ αὐτόν ’me myself as well’) · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’ as direct object of a verb: ἤλασε δ’ αὐτόν ’struck him’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’him(self)’ · also reinforcing σε: ’you yourself’ (σ’ αὐτὸν)
αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg.: ’himself’, reinforcing a personal pronoun (σοὶ δ’ αὐτῷ ’to you yourself’) · also used alone as a plain personal pronoun, ’him’, not reinforcing anything (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ μηχανόωνται ’are plotting against him’) · also with a noun, ’own, very’, in the dat. of accompaniment: αὐτῷ φάρει ’with the cloak itself, cloak and all’ · also reinforcing a 1st-person pronoun: ’myself’ (ἐμοὶ αὐτῷ)
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
βάλεν: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, in tmesis with ἀμφί: ’threw about’ · also in tmesis with ἐπί (βάλεν δ’ ἐπὶ ... ἑκάστῳ = ἐπέβαλε): ’threw over, cast upon’ · also in tmesis with παρά (πάρ … βάλεν = παρέβαλε): ’threw beside, set before’
βουλευσέμεν: βουλεύω — plan, devise, contrive; fut. inf., epic -σέμεν (= Attic βουλεύσειν)
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γίγνονται: γίγνομαι — become, come into being; pres. 3 pl.: ’they come to be’ (of creatures that exist upon earth)
γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; gen. sg. (Ionic η for α)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γούνων: γόνυ — knee; neut. gen. pl., epic γούνων (= Attic γονάτων)
γυίων: γυῖον — limb; neut. gen. pl. (used chiefly in the plural)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δεῦρ: δεῦρο — hither, here; adv., elided (δεῦρ’ = δεῦρο)
δι: διά — through; prep. + acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through (the night)’
δύνανται: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 3 pl.
δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῶκέν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, with movable ν (= Attic ἔδωκε(ν))
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb: ’the house’
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο)
εἰνὶ: ἐν (epic εἰνί, ἐνί) — in, at, on; prep. + dat.
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’
εἰσαγαγοῦσα: εἰσάγω — lead in, bring in; aor. 2 part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having led in’
εἴδατα: εἶδαρ — food, dish; neut. acc. pl. εἴδατα: ’dishes’
εἵλετο: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took up (for herself)’ · also with ἐκ in tmesis: ’took away from’ (ἐκ … εἵλετο)
εἷσε: ἵζω — make sit, set, station (causative); aor. act. 3 sg.: ’set, seated, stationed’
εὐνήν: εὐνή — bed, bedding, marriage-bed; fem. acc. sg. · also of an animal’s lair, den (ἑὴν εἰσήλυθεν εὐνήν ’came into his own lair’, of the lion in the simile)
εὐνηθῆναι: εὐνάω — lay in bed; aor. pass. inf. εὐνηθῆναι, used in a middle sense: ’to lie (in bed)’
εὐνῆς: εὐνή — bed, couch; fem. gen. sg.
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle
θάλαμόν: θάλαμος — chamber, room; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
θεά: θεά — goddess; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form): ’goddess!’
θεοί: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεοῦ: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., genitive with a verb of hearing · also genitive governed by a preposition (ἄνευ θεοῦ ’without a god’) · also possessive genitive with a noun: ’of the god’ (θεοῦ δαῖτα) · also gen. with ἄρχομαι, ’from the god’ (the point of departure)
θνητοῖσι: θνητός — mortal; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
θοῇ: θοός — swift, quick (standing epithet of ships); fem. dat. sg.
θρόνου: θρόνος — chair, seat; masc. gen. sg.
θυμοφθόρον: θυμοφθόρος — soul-destroying, heart-consuming; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἄχος
θυμός: θυμός — heart, spirit; masc. nom. sg. · also life, the breath of life
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θύρῃσι: θύρη — door; dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic θύραις; Ionic η for α)
κάλει: καλέω — call, summon; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκάλει)
κάτα: κατά — down, throughout; prep. + acc., placed after its noun with anastrophe: κραναὴν Ἰθάκην κάτα ’throughout rocky Ithaca’ · also standing after its verb, not after a noun: ἔχῃ κάτα δῆμον ἅπαντα ’holds throughout the whole land’ (κατά + acc., or tmesis for κατέχῃ)
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
κέλεαι: κέλομαι — bid, command, urge, exhort; pres. mid. 2 sg.
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
κίρκη: Κίρκη — Circe, the enchantress goddess; fem. nom. sg.
κίρκης: Κίρκη — Circe, the enchantress goddess; fem. gen. sg.
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κακὰ ἔργα ’bad deeds’
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ἦμαρ: ’evil’ (κακὸν ἦμαρ ’the evil day’)
κακῶν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. pl.: ’of ills, of misfortunes’
καλλιπλοκάμοιο: καλλιπλόκαμος — with beautiful locks, fair-plaited (κάλλος + πλόκαμος ’lock’); fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl.
καλὴν: καλός — beautiful, fair; fem. acc. sg.
καλῇ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; fem. dat. sg.
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’)
κελεύεις: κελεύω — bid, command, order; pres. 2 sg.
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’
κιόντι: κίω — go, walk; pres. part. masc. dat. sg., agreeing with μοι: ’as (I) went’
κρατὸς: κάρη — head; gen. sg. κρατός, from the by-form κράς, genitive of separation: ’from his head’ · also in ἐπὶ κρατὸς + gen., ’at the head, top’ (ἐπὶ κρατὸς λιμένος ’at the head of the harbour’)
κύπελλα: κύπελλον — cup, drinking-vessel; neut. acc. pl.
λάβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλαβε)
λίπ: λίπα — richly, thickly; adv. (perh. instead an elided case-form of a noun ’fat’, cf. λίπος), elided (λίπ’ = λίπα) · also λείπω — leave; aor. imper. 2 sg., elided (λίπ’ = λίπε): ’leave (me)’
λοῦσέν: λούω — bathe, wash; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, accented before an enclitic (λοῦσέν τε)
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big, tall; masc. acc. sg.
μέλαν: μέλας — black, dark; neut. nom./acc. sg.
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται)
μακάρων: μάκαρ — blessed, happy; masc. gen. pl., epithet of the gods
μακρὸν: μακρός — long, far; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’far, loudly’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’tall’ (κίονα μακρὸν ’a tall pillar’)
μεγάλοιο: μέγας — great; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great room, house; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), plural for a single house
μελίφρονα: μελίφρων — honey-hearted, sweet to the heart; masc. acc. sg., epithet of wine
μελαίνῃ: μέλας — black; standing epithet of ships; fem. dat. sg. μέλαινα · also modifying a different noun, not a ship (μελαίνῃ φρικί ’with a dark ripple’, of the sea’s surface)
μενεαίνων: μενεαίνω — be furious, rage; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after, in quest of; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (μετ’ … βαῖνε = μετέβαινε ’followed’) · also + dat., ’among, between’ (μετ’ ἀμφοτέροισιν ’between the two of them’)
μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic μευ (= Attic μου): ’of me’, with κλύω ’hear me’
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νίψασθαι: νίζω — wash; aor. inf. mid., purpose: ’to wash themselves’
νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
νῶι: ἐγώ (dual νῶι) — we two; acc. dual: ’the two of us’ (μετὰ νῶι ’after the two of us’)  ·  also used as nom. dual: νῶι … ἱκόμεθ’ ’we two have come’
ξεστὴν: ξεστός — planed smooth, polished (from ξέω); fem. acc. sg.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’)
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’)
πένοντο: πένομαι — labor at, be busy with, toil; impf. 3 pl.
παρέθηκε: παρατίθημι — set beside, serve; aor. 3 sg.
παρεόντων: πάρειμι — be present, be at hand; pres. part. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic παρόντων): ’of what was at hand’
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’)
πεπληγυῖα: πλήσσω — strike; perf. act. part. fem. nom. sg., with aorist sense: ’having struck’
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
περικαλλέος: περικαλλής — very beautiful; fem. gen. sg.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’again and again’ (πολλὰ περιτροπέοντες)
πολλὸν: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’much’ · also attributive, neut. nom. sg. agreeing with μέθυ: ’much (wine)’ · also neut. acc. sg. as substantive object: ’much (wine)’
προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; adv./prep. + gen.
προσέειπον: προσεῖπον (aor. of πρόσφημι) — speak to, address; aor. 1 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προχόῳ: πρόχοος — pitcher, jug (for pouring); dat. sg.
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’)
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
πόθι: πόθι — where?; interrog. adv. (Attic ποῦ), suffix -θι of place where
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also used adverbially: ‘much, often’ (πόλλ’ ἐπέεσσιν ‘again and again with words’)
πόρε: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’gave’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (same form): τοῦτο πόρε ’give this!’
πόρφυρε: πορφύρω — heave, seethe, churn (properly of the sea darkening/heaving); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, applied metaphorically to a troubled heart
πῆμα: πῆμα — woe, calamity, disaster; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’woe’
πῇ: πῇ — where?, to what place?; interrog. adv.
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’
σέ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’you’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’)
σίτῳ: σῖτος — grain, food; masc. dat. sg.
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
στὰς: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stood, standing’
σφι: σφι — epic dat. pl. pron. ’to/for them’ (= Attic αὐτοῖς)
σύες: σῦς (ὗς) — swine, pig; masc./fem. nom. pl.
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’ · also adverb ’along, with (us)’ construed with ἔχοντες, which takes the object (σὺν … χεῖρας ἔχοντες ’having hands along with us’)
σῆς: σός — your, yours (sg.); possessive adj., fem. gen. sg.
σῖτον: σῖτος — bread, grain, the staple of a meal; acc. sg.
σῦς: σῦς — swine, pig, boar; masc./fem. nom. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τάων: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic τῶν): ’of these/those women’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε) · also in the idiom ὅ τε (= ὅτι) ’in that, because’, giving a reason: ὅ τέ με … ἀποβῆναι ἀνώγει ’in that he bids me step off’
τέσσαρες: τέσσαρες — four; numeral, masc. nom. pl. (Attic τέτταρες)
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’)
τίθει: τίθημι — put, place, set; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτίθει)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
ταμίη: ταμίη — housekeeper, stewardess, woman with charge of the stores (Attic ταμία, Ionic η for α); nom. sg.
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελεύτησέν: τελευτάω — bring to an end, complete, fulfil; aor. 3 sg.
τεῆς: τεός — your (sg.); adj., fem. gen. sg., epic (= σός)
τεῦχε: τεύχω — make, prepare, build; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτευχε)
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
τλαίης: τλῆναι (defective, root τλα-) — endure, bear, hold out; aor. opt. 2 sg.: ’you could endure’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοκῆες: τοκεύς — parent, begetter (from τίκτω); nom. pl.
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’ · also neut. gen. sg., partitive, ’of it’ (τοῦ μὲν ὅσον τ’ ὄργυιαν ’of it, about a fathom’)
τρίποδος: τρίπους — tripod, three-footed cauldron-stand; masc. gen. sg.
τροίης: Τροία — Troy; gen. sg. (Ionic -ης for Attic -ας)
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’)
τῆ: τῆ — here, take (this); old imperatival interjection used in handing something over
φάρμακ: φάρμακον — drug, potion, medicine; neut. acc. pl., elided (φάρμακ’ = φάρμακα)
φάρμακα: φάρμακον — drug, potion (healing or harmful); neut. nom./acc. pl.
φάρμακον: φάρμακον — drug, potion (healing or deadly); acc. sg.
φάτ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (φάτ’ = φάτο)
φέρουσα: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’carrying, bringing’
φαεινὰς: φαεινός — shining, bright; fem. acc. pl.
φημι: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 1 sg.
φιλότητι: φιλότης — friendship, love, affection; fem. dat. sg.
φρονέουσ: φρονέω — think, be minded, ponder; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., elided, uncontracted (φρονέουσ’ = φρονέουσα)
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
φῦ: φύω — grow, put forth; mid. sense ’took firm hold of, clasped’; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist), tmesis with ἐν (ἔν … φῦ = ἐνέφυ)
χέρνιβα: χέρνιψ — water for washing the hands (χείρ + νίζω); acc. sg.
χαλεπὸν: χαλεπός — harsh, grievous, painful; neut. nom. sg.
χαριζομένη: χαρίζομαι — do a favour, be free with, give freely of (+ gen.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
χλαῖναν: χλαῖνα — cloak, mantle; fem. acc. sg.
χρυσείῃ: χρύσεος — golden; fem. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῇ)
χρύσεια: χρύσεος — golden; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσᾶ)
ἀλλήλοισιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ἀμειβόμενος: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. masc. nom. sg. mid.
ἀμφίπολοι: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. nom. pl. · also fem. voc. pl., address: ’handmaids!’
ἀμφίπολος: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, woman in attendance; nom. sg.
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀν: ἀνά (elided ἀν’) — up, along; prep. + acc.: ἀν’ ἰθύν ’in a straight line’
ἀνέκαιε: ἀνακαίω — kindle, light up; impf. 3 sg., augmented after the preverb
ἀνήιον: ἄνειμι — go up; impf. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνῄειν): ’I went up’
ἀνδράσι: ἀνήρ — man; masc. dat. pl., epic ἀνδράσι
ἀνιόντα: ἄνειμι — come back, go up; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’on his way back’
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’) · also + gen., ’up onto’ (ἀνὰ νηὸς ἔβην ’I went up on board’) · also + acc., proportional, ’to, at the rate of’ (ἀνὰ εἴκοσι μέτρα ’at twenty measures (of water) to the one cup’) · also in tmesis with a verb of signalling, construed with a dat.: ἀνὰ … ὀφρύσι νεῦον ’I signalled with raised brows’ · also + acc. θυμόν, ’in (their) heart’ (ἀνὰ θυμὸν ἐθάμβεον ’they were amazed in their hearts’)
ἀπέβη: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀπ-έ-βη)
ἀργεϊφόντης: Ἀργεϊφόντης — ’Argeïphontes’, standing epithet of Hermes, conventionally ’slayer of Argus’; masc. nom. sg.; the meaning is disputed, not actually known
ἀργυρέας: ἀργύρεος — silver, made of silver; adj., fem. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀργυρᾶς)
ἀργυρέοιο: ἀργύρεος — of silver; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -οιο (= Attic ἀργυροῦ)
ἀσάμινθον: ἀσάμινθος — bath, bathing-tub; fem. acc. sg.
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄκριας: ἄκρις — hilltop, peak, height; fem. acc. pl.
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄνθος: ἄνθος — flower, blossom; neut. acc. sg.
ἄορ: ἄορ — sword (poetic, = ξίφος); neut. acc. sg.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows)
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐθέλοιμι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 1 sg. (hypothetical wish)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκέλευον: κελεύω — urge, exhort, bid; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented · also impf. 1 sg., augmented: ’I urged’
ἐκίρνα: κίρνημι — mix (wine with water; = κεράννυμι); impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἐκεράννυ)
ἐλάσῃ: ἐλαύνω — drive; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’may drive’
ἐλαίῳ: ἔλαιον — olive oil; neut. dat. sg.
ἐλεύσεσθαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; fut. inf. mid.
ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’)
ἐξελθοῦσα: ἐξέρχομαι — go out, come out; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having come out’
ἐοικώς: ἔοικα — be like, resemble, seem; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’resembling, looking like’
ἐπιβήμεναι: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, set foot on (+ gen.); aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἐπιβῆναι)
ἐπιθεῖσα: ἐπιτίθημι — lay on, add; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having laid on’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐρυσσάμενος: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., of launching a ship: ’having drawn down, having launched’ · also of a sword, ’drawing (from the sheath)’: ξίφος ὀξὺ ἐρυσσάμενος ’having drawn a sharp sword’
ἐρχομένῳ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. part. mid. masc. dat. sg.: ’(to him) going’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσθλόν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἐσθλὸν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut./masc. acc. sg.
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐστίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable form
ἐτάνυσσε: τανύω — stretch, draw out; aor. 3 sg., double σ metrical
ἐφάμην: φημί — say, speak; impf. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted: ’I was speaking, I spoke’
ἐφόρει: φορέω — carry, bear (along, repeatedly); impf. 3 sg.: ’was carrying, bore along’
ἐών: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὤν), accented ἐών before a pause: ’being’ (τοῖος ἐών ’being such’)
ἑρμείας: Ἑρμείας — Hermes, epic form of Ἑρμῆς; nom. sg.
ἑτάρους: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); acc. pl.
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen., placed after its pronoun with anastrophe: τοῦ ... ἔκ = ἐκ τοῦ ’from him’ · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε ’called by name’)
ἔκλυεν: κλύω — hear, hear of; aor. 3 sg.
ἔκπιον: ἐκπίνω — drink up, drain; aor. 3 pl. (ἔκ … πιον): ’they drank down’
ἔμελλον: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 pl. · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I was destined, was about to’ + fut. inf.
ἔν: ἐν — in, on; preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἔν … φῦ = ἐνέφυ ’took firm hold’) · also prep. + dat., ’on’, accented before the enclitic τε (ἔν τε τάπησι ’on rugs’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’)
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with anastrophe, accent thrown back after its noun (δήμῳ ἔνι = ἐν δήμῳ) · also = ἔνεστι, ἔνεισι (ἔνι with no case): ’there is, there are in it/among them’ (ἄνδρες νηῶν ἔνι τέκτονες ’men, shipwrights, are among them’)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔρχεαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἔρχῃ): ’you go’
ἔρχεο: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρχου)
ἔρχευ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; imper. 2 sg., epic ἔρχευ (= Attic ἔρχου)
ἔς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; prep. + acc.
ἔσκε: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, iterative: ’used to be, was’
ἔστην: ἵστημι — set up; intrans. stand; aor. 1 sg. ἔστην (root aorist): ’I stood’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἔχουσα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕκαστα: ἕκαστος — each, every; neut. acc. pl. used substantivally: ’each thing, everything’
ἕρκος: ἕρκος — fence, barrier, enclosure; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἕταροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl., epic by-form ἕταροι (= ἑταῖροι)
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’
ἡδὺν: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; masc. acc. sg.
ἤια: ἤια — provisions for a journey; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl. (subject): ’our stores’ · also a different word, impf. 1 sg. of εἶμι ’go’: ’I was going’, unrelated to this noun
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἥνδανε: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing to; impf. 3 sg., augmented (η- from the root’s original digamma, contracted; the same augment as the uncontracted ἑήνδανε in this part; unaugmented ἄνδανε); + dat.: ’was pleasing to’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’)
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with κὰδ in tmesis: ’let down’) · also of hurling a missile: ’hurled’ (ἧκε … κορυφὴν ὄρεος ’hurled the peak of a mountain’)
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱερὰς: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. acc. pl.
ἵξεσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; fut. inf. mid. (ἵξομαι), after ἔμελλε: ’to be about to reach’
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀλοφυρομένη: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, wail, mourn; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
ὀλοφώια: ὀλοφώιος — baneful, harmful, deceitful (formation disputed, perhaps connected with ὄλλυμι ’destroy’); adj. used substantively, neut. acc. pl.: ’baneful arts/wiles’
ὀμόσσαι: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. inf., epic σσ (= Attic ὀμόσαι): ’to swear’
ὀνόμαζε: ἐξονομάζω — call by name, address directly; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, tmesis (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε) · also ὀνομάζω (simple, no preverb) — name, call by name, tell the name of; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’name (him)!’ (τρίτον ἄνδρ’ ὀνόμαζε)
ὀνόμαζεν: ὀνομάζω — call by name, name; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ὠνόμαζε); with ἐκ in tmesis (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζεν) ’called by name’
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg.
ὁππότε: ὁππότε (Attic ὁπότε) — whenever, when; conj., + subj. and κε in a general temporal clause · also introducing an indirect question, + pres. indic.: ’when’ (ὁππότε Τηλέμαχος νεῖτ(αι) ’when Telemachus is to return’)
ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron. (indefinite with τε/τις: ὅν τινα = ὅστις, ’whatever’); masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τινά · also plain relative pron., masc. acc. sg., not accented for a following enclitic: ’whom’ (ὅν ῥα καθεῖσεν ’whom he had stationed’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’)
ὑπένερθε: ὑπένερθε(ν) — below, underneath, beneath; adv., + gen.: ’below’ (ὑπένερθε Χίοιο ’below Chios’)
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + acc. (ὑπὲρ μόρον ’beyond one’s portion’) · also + gen., literally ’over, above’ (ὑπὲρ ἀργυρέοιο λέβητος ’over a silver basin’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο) · also + gen., marking agent with a passive verb/participle beyond dying, ’by’: μεγάλου ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς ’lifted up by a great wave’ · also + gen., of cause: ὑπὸ ῥιπῆς ’at the rush (of the throw)’
ὕδωρ: ὕδωρ — water; neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb (ἄνεμός τε καὶ ὕδωρ ‘wind and current’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὤιξε: ἀνοίγνυμι — open; aor. 3 sg., epic ὤιξε (= Attic ἀνέῳξε)
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’)
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
ῥάβδῳ: ῥάβδος — rod, wand; fem. dat. sg., instrumental
ῥήγεα: ῥῆγος — rug, coverlet (laid on a bed); neut. nom./acc. pl.
